method: Ran `<cli> --help` on each competitor CLI INSTALLED ON THIS MACHINE and counted mentions of verif/proof/receipt/attest/evidence, then READ every hit rather than trusting the count.
claim: No installed competitor CLI exposes a command that verifies the agent's OWN output. Loki does.
not_claimed: Devin and Replit Agent ship no local CLI, so they are NOT covered and no claim is made about them. Absence from a --help listing is not proof of absence from a product: a web UI or an API could expose something the CLI does not.

results.note: All 8 hits are --verify-ssl (SSL cert validation) and --git-commit-verify (git pre-commit hooks). NEITHER verifies the agent's output. Counted 8, read all 8; the count alone would have been misleading.
Claude Code. Also checked audit/checksum/hash/sign/report/artifact: no matches.
Cursor agent CLI (cursor 3.13.25 installed). Widened search matched only 'Sign out', unrelated.

`loki proof verify <id>` recomputes the receipt hash and re-derives the diff. Demonstrated on a real receipt: hash_ok=true, headline_consistent=true; tampering one fact (files_changed -> 9999) flips hash_ok to false.

coverage: 5 of the 6 named competitors have a local CLI on this machine and all 5 were measured.
